images.title: 60 sixties make one 3600
images.composition: Plain white background, the main object large and centred with wide empty margins, no scenery, no characters, no extra decoration. Before and after: two rows of three place boxes, the top row with a count that is too big, a curved arrow, and the regrouped row below.
images.exact_structure: Column headers above both rows, in grey (#6B7280): 3600s, 60s, 1s. Top row: three boxes holding 2, 75 and 10; the box with 75 has a vermilion (#D55E00) outline and vermilion number. One curved amber (#E69F00) arrow goes from the 75 box to the bottom row's 3600s box. Bottom row: three boxes holding 3, 15 and 10; the 3 is in green (#009E73). Exactly 6 boxes. Nothing else in the frame.
rejection: any count of objects, cells, ticks or rows that differs from the numbers stated in the spec
any text beyond the listed visible text, or any listed text misspelled or altered
any board name, publisher name, book title, page number or curriculum branding anywhere in the frame
a hyphen used in place of a minus sign on any labelled number
images.takeaway: No count may be 60 or more: 60 sixties are regrouped into one 3600.

image_decisions.why: Regrouping is a change between two states, so a before and after of the place counts shows it best.
